name: Junk removal & cleanouts — independent, Chicago north/west side + near-west suburbs (B2B-first: property managers, self-storage, restoration)
summary: Job-based hauling service. Each 'customer' is one paid job (monthly churn = 100%; active = jobs in the month). Demand = company inbound leads (LSA/search, property-manager, storage and restoration accounts) ramping over ~24 months to a single-territory plateau calibrated to Junk King and College Hunks FDD unit revenues. Crew labour and tipping fees are variable COGS (hourly crews, per-ton disposal); trucks are added by capacity (jobs/month) as 'staff' lines carrying each truck's fixed costs. Founder drives truck #1 in year 1 (unpaid inside operating profit). Operating profit is before owner compensation.
evidence_notes: Ticket and cost structure: Junk King CY2024 avg $399/job (median $389); labour 20.6%, dumping 7.2%, gasoline 3.3% of sales; gross profit 56.3% after 13% franchise/call-centre fees [B, WS18-S001].

Unit revenue/profit: College Hunks CY2025 franchised stores 13-36 months median sales $691k, median EBITDA $44k (before truck payments and owner pay); 60+ months $1.56M / $137k [B, C8-S017]. Junk King avg $554k, median $436k, bottom quartile $194k, top quartile $1.12M [B, WS18-S001].

Independent owner economics (seller-claimed, D): Naperville property-cleanout/junk firm est. 2020, 4 employees, revenue $814,489, cash flow $219,912, asking $284,999 [DF-S018]; Chicagoland 4-territory franchise est. 2021 listed with $25k cash flow [DF-S019].

Chicago disposal: SWANCC Glenview Transfer Station (from 1 Mar 2026) $100/ton commercial & residential waste ($25 min), white goods $25/item, mattresses $75/item [B, DF-S016]; Chicago-region landfills: 4 sites, 12.4 years life [A, DF-S017].

Licensing: Chicago 'Private Scavenger Vehicle' regulated licence is held per vehicle (337 active vehicle licences, 37 holders; 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Chicagoland holds 10) and 29 'Junk Peddler' licences are active [A, DF-S015]; fee MISSING.

Model structure: leads at plateau back-solved from franchise unit revenues — cons ~59 jobs x $380 = ~$270k/yr (Junk King bottom half); base ~118 x $420 = ~$590k/yr (between Junk King median $436k and College Hunks yr1-3 median $691k); opt ~185 x $470 = ~$1.04M (Junk King top quartile $1.12M). Truck capacity ~55 jobs/month (≈2.5 jobs/day).
Churn-based stress tests and the churn tornado bar are not meaningful here (churn is structurally 100% in a job-based model); read CAC, ticket, margin, labour and demand tests.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Entity, insurance, used truck, Chicago private-scavenger vehicle licence (category documented [A, DF-S015]; processing time and fee MISSING).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Consumers book same day to one week (Stage C memo).
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Months to plateau. College Hunks stores reach median $691k within 13-36 months with brand + call centre [B, C8-S017]; independent assumed no faster (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Company inbound leads/month at plateau, back-solved from franchise unit revenues (see evidence notes) [B, WS18-S001, C8-S017].
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Quote -> booked paid job; consumers shop 2-3 quotes (E).
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: No sales reps; B2B account development is founder work inside the lead driver.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Repeat B2B jobs (property-manager turnovers, storage auctions, restoration contents) per 100 jobs in prior month.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Junk King CY2024 avg $399/job, median $389 [B, WS18-S001]; Chicago premium +5% in base (E).
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: After crew labour and disposal only. Junk King labour 20.6% + dumping 7.2% [B, WS18-S001]; Chicago: labour 24% (laborer median $40,550, light-truck driver $47,950 [C, DF-S020], loaded) and disposal ~11% at $100/ton + item fees [B, DF-S016] (E for the uplift).
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Fuel ~4% (Junk King 3.3% [B, WS18-S001], Chicago uplift E) + card processing ~3% (E).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: College Hunks franchisees spend median $83k on $691k sales (~12%) on local marketing ON TOP of brand fund and call centre [B, C8-S017]; base $55 = 13% of ticket; junk-specific LSA CPL MISSING.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website/GBP, truck wrap amortisation, BOMA/realtor association dues, donation-partner materials.
drivers.dso_days__source: Consumers pay at completion; property managers/restoration net-30 (~15% of revenue).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Transfer-station fees paid at the scale [B, DF-S016]; crews paid bi-weekly (ignored).
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Used truck + equipment + insurance deposits + 3 months fixed costs.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Truck replacement cycle heavy relative to profit.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Naperville listing asks $285k on $220k cash flow (1.3x) [DF-S018]; franchise resale listings ask more on thin cash flow [DF-S019]. Asking ≠ sold.

staff.role: Additional truck unit (fixed costs: insurance, maintenance, licence, parking)
staff.notes: Not a person: capacity trigger for trucks (≈55 jobs/truck/month). Fixed cost = box-truck commercial auto (~$800/mo, E; small-biz avg $245/mo is a floor [D, DF-S034]) + maintenance (~$600/mo, E). Crew wages are variable COGS. Capex = used 14-16 ft box/dump truck (E — requires quotes).
Chicago dispatcher median $58,900; CSR $47,100 [C, DF-S033]; loaded x1.2 (E).

overhead.notes: Commercial auto small-biz avg $245/mo is a floor for box trucks [D, DF-S034]; E.

College Hunks stores (13-36 months) report median insurance ~$49k/yr (incl. moving and more trucks) [B, C8-S017]; this line + truck lines ≈ $37k/yr at 2 trucks in base (E). WC on crew wages also inside labour %.

overhead.item: Booking/FSM software + AI photo-quote and call answering
overhead.notes: Housecall Pro Essentials $149-189/mo [B, DF-S035] + AI tools (E).
